description: This file contains implementation of the inet_pton function for converting IPv4 and IPv6 addresses from presentation to network format, including internal helper functions inet_pton4 and inet_pton6, with conditional compilation for IPv6 support.

methods.name: inet_pton4
methods.description: Converts IPv4 address from dotted-decimal string to binary form.

methods.name: inet_pton6
methods.description: Converts IPv6 address from presentation to binary form, with support for shorthand notation.
